Lets make sure that both "systems" and "manager" show up in this, otherwise it looks like it's the one LogService to rule them all.  There's about 6, so it's important to differentiate.  (I know this because we didn't used to differentiate).
Done
"AND BMC" isn't an API.  This should be named "managers". Redfish doesn't have a concept of "BMC"

Sure. Managers is better but this is all under /bmc and we have BMC roles, BMC journal, etc, so we could say we have this wrong in a lot of places. Lets change to Managers though. 

https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/55385c705c0efc58b88ff885b78ee65acb455b85/redfish-core/lib/manager_logservices_journal.hpp#L342
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/55385c705c0efc58b88ff885b78ee65acb455b85/redfish-core/lib/update_service.hpp#L925
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/55385c705c0efc58b88ff885b78ee65acb455b85/redfish-core/lib/roles.hpp#L128

Agreed, we have this wrong in a lot of places because the migration from bmc->managers for this effort was half completed.

I normally wouldn't comment, but we're doing a rename in this patch, we might as well rename to be what we expect, and not rename TO a pattern we know isn't great.
Makes sense, we call it Managers
Got it. Renamed to "SystemsAndManagers". Applied this to all other patches that were affected too.
